skeleton_method: skimage.morphology.skeletonize default 2-D Zhang; no pruning or smoothing
coordinate_output: 8-neighbor skeleton graph paths in original integer XY; graph branches are not physical wire instances
metric_definition: skeleton-pixel precision: prediction skeleton pixels <=t from reference union; recall: reference union pixels <=t from prediction skeleton; F1 harmonic mean; union pixel counts, not object counts
mask_band_metric: fraction of foreground pixels inside reference distance band; auxiliary agreement proxy, not true segmentation precision because reference is polylines

conditions.name: B_vlm_keep_only
conditions.interpretation: Diagnostic strict acceptance: uncertain candidates omitted; not an approved deployment

conditions.name: C_remove_vehicle_only
conditions.interpretation: Conservative policy: retain uncertain originals; remove only rejected vehicle

conditions.name: D_visual_segments_only
conditions.interpretation: Non-independent assistant visual selection frozen in prior review; not automatic

conditions.name: E_hypothetical_manual_partial_repair
conditions.interpretation: Hypothetical human-assisted replacement inside four parent crops only; four repairs were not approved; outside crops retained
